title: Steak with mushrooms and greens
summary: Steak with mushrooms and greens is a british dinner built around lean beef frying steak and chestnut mushrooms, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Steak with mushrooms and greens chopped before the pan goes on. Pat lean beef frying steak dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook lean beef frying steak until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook chestnut mushrooms and kale until hot and lightly browned. Return lean beef frying steak and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Steak with mushrooms and greens, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.
steps.tip: Taste Steak with mushrooms and greens before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
